BiblicalUsage: Pithon was a son of Micah, a descendant of Saul, named in the Benjamite genealogy in 1 Chronicles 8:35 and again in 1 Chronicles 9:41. He belongs to the family of the first king, listed twice in the records of the returned exiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the family of Saul is remembered long after the crown passed to David.
